items: Prices are per indoor unit. Outdoor units are checked as part of every service.

items.q: How often should I service my aircond?
items.a: Every 3–4 months for bedrooms and living rooms used daily; every 6 months for guest rooms. A chemical wash once a year.

items.q: Do I need to be home?
items.a: Someone needs to let us in and switch on the units. The work itself takes about 45 minutes per unit.

items.q: What if the unit needs a part?
items.a: We'll show you the problem, quote the part on the spot, and only proceed if you agree. No surprise charges.

items.q: Is the estimate the final price?
items.a: For wall-mounted units up to 2.5HP, yes. Bigger units or extra work are confirmed on WhatsApp before we start.
